test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly of the State.
The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Vice-President.
The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Legislative Council of the State.
The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Council of States.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly of the State.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly of the State.**
 
• This principle of collective responsibility is enshrined in Article 164 of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Council of Ministers, headed by the Chief Minister, must maintain the confidence of the Legislative Assembly to remain in power.
 
• They are accountable for their actions and policies and can be removed by a vote of no confidence in the Legislative Assembly.
 
• This ensures that the executive branch remains answerable to the legislature, maintaining a system of checks and balances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule **of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Union List has been amended several times to meet the evolving needs of the nation.
